column1: # known-issues.tsv - the issue table of issue-scan.sh (OnePlus Pad 4 "iceland", installed Fedora 44, 16 Oct 2026).
# Sources: the project's feature matrix, its boot-log review, its hardware inventory and the scans of the
# installed tablet (the 16 Oct 2026 groups are in the block before the display rows).
# Columns (TAB separated): id  class  scope  pattern  row  status  note
#   class   KNOWN (a recorded issue) or INFO (looks like an error, is not one)
#   scope   k = kernel line, j = user-space journal line (matched as "ident: message"), s = scan check line
#   pattern POSIX extended regex (awk), case-sensitive; first matching row wins (keep specific rows first)
#   row     the feature-matrix row (or the ledger id) it belongs to
#   status  short state; "regression-if-seen" = fixed earlier, a hit means it came back
